messages:
Maya Singh: Drafting a compact customer-facing mini-runbook for activation: covers adaptive prefill, three batching presets, streaming safety-net, and a simple renewal signal. Aim: AE can paste this in an onboarding email.
Ethan Cole: Love the "mini" idea. Keep customer language plain, add one line engineers can copy for non-prod config.
Maya Singh: Customer opener (one line): 'Well prime a small, representative set of your prompts, keep a tiny warm pool for core flows, and switch to a safe polling mode if streaming becomes unreliable.'
Riley Park: Suggest adding adaptive priming note: we start with a stratified sample (50% high-frequency, 50% edge cases) and expand if hit rate < threshold. That helps capture renewal-risk patterns.
Alicia Torres: Renewal trigger proposal: if live token consumption < 60% of expected baseline over 5 days OR weekly active sessions drop >40% -> flag for outreach.
Maya Singh: Customer pasteable prefill snippet (non-prod first):
```
# MINI PREFILL (paste to infra notes)
prefill: on
sample_strategy: stratified  # options: random | stratified
sample_size: 200
warm_pool_size: 3
warm_pool_ttl_h: 48
```
Ethan Cole: ENG batching presets (short):
- latency-focused: batch_window_ms=40, max_batch_tokens=1024
- balanced: batch_window_ms=120, max_batch_tokens=3072
- throughput-first: batch_window_ms=250, max_batch_tokens=8192
(These are suggestions; start balanced for trials.)
Riley Park: Observability (customer-friendly names + thresholds):
- prefill_success_rate >= 95%
- cache_hit_rate >= 70%
- p95_time_to_first_token_ms < 500ms
- stream_errors_per_1k_requests < 5
If any are breached, run escalation.
Maya Singh: Short escalation playbook (CS + ENG):
1) CS: collect 3 representative failing prompts + note client environment.
2) CS: re-run prefill in non-prod with same sample_strategy.
3) ENG: check cache key construction, confirm model pin & variant, and run a quick trace.
4) ENG oncall: enable polling fallback and notify CS.
Alicia Torres: Small customer-facing fallback UX line: 'If streaming pauses, we may temporarily use polling to keep responses reliable; well notify you and follow up with root cause.'
Ethan Cole: Tiny curl for ENG toggle (internal):
```bash
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.internal/v1/fallbacks \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"mode":"polling","interval_ms":400}'
```
Riley Park: PromQL example (p95 TTF over 5m):
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(response_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le))
```
Maya Singh: Customer 2-line email snippet: 'Were priming your instance and will monitor core metrics for 72 hours. If you notice slow or missing responses, reply with 2 example prompts and well investigate immediately.'
Alicia Torres: Action items: @Ethan finalize ENG presets and curl command; @Riley add PromQL samples to tech appendix; @Maya assemble one-pager and add renewal trigger to CS playbook.
runbook-bot: New runbook created: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cs/mini-activation-prime (access: customer-success, eng)
Maya Singh: Ill publish the draft to the CS drive and ping this thread when done. Drop any very short snippets here and Ill include. :white_check_mark:
